title: Direct graphical manipulation
summary: Implement pointer manipulation for semantic containers without replacing the model with absolute coordinates.
criteria: Implement selection, drag/reorder/reparent and resize with an immutable gesture preview, one validated transaction on commit, cancellation and stale-revision/session checks.
Implement applicable snapping, alignment and pan behavior; retain semantic constraints and test unsupported operations explicitly.
blockers: Native desktop interaction and prototype comparison deferred to RUST-04 acceptance; non-flow layouts and runtime parity remain explicitly unsupported in this slice.
